title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
summary: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.

title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
summary: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
summary: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.

title: ‘Roadmap is Complete,' Cardano Founder Charles Hoskinson Says
summary: Cardano's ADA token is down almost 95% from its all-time high, and investors don't seem to be happy that the roadmap is complete.
